decoder_model: garnet_coherence (simulated medians; not fitted to this data)

columns.det: detection event (stabilizer, round t); no-reset: m_t xor m_(t-2)
columns.meas: raw ancilla measurement; accumulates without reset
columns.fires: count of detection events on this stabilizer
columns.lag1: pairs fired in rounds t, t+1
columns.lag2: pairs fired in rounds t, t+2: no-reset readout-error signature
columns.maxrun: longest streak of consecutive rounds fired
columns.space: adjacent stabilizer pairs firing together in round t (data-error signature)
columns.diag: adjacent pairs at t and t+1 (mid-round / hook-error signature)
columns.rounds_active: rounds with at least one event
columns.weight_trend: least-squares slope of per-round weight vs round (leakage grows it)
